coverage: Twentyfour production-nameplate families with documented generation/era splits; not a complete versions catalogue. Selected three2020Aviator powertrain combinations and one2021Corsair engine specification.
excluded: Futura,Star,L100,Sentinel,Quicksilver and other concepts or one-off parade vehicles.
ContinentalMarkII retained only as explicitly separate-division predecessor insideMarkseries, not an unqualified Lincoln.
Nautilus rename retained with MKX family; NavigatorL not duplicate card.
gaps: Historic coachbuilt/body variants, most generation-specific specifications and technical versions remain incomplete.
Continental modern postwar series and Markseries are family placeholders awaiting a full era split; no uninterrupted production implied.
MKXII renameNautilus is separately labelled as a facelift period, not an independent new construction.
Photographs illustrate only the explicitly selected eras; photos do not prove engine, precise MY or body specification.
Custom, Versailles, ChinaZ and some Continental eras have no accepted photo from limited paced category searches; alternatives not exhausted.
Aviator OEM hp/ft-lb and EPAmpg remain unconverted; Corsair net180kW is distinct from rated182kW.

validation.checks: Unique production identities, scoped versions, exact Commons credits/aspects, indexed nulls and retained conflicts.
